Uses of Package
hadur117.core.melee

Packages that use hadur117.core.melee
Package
Description
hadur117.core
Hadur 2's core: the whole of the robot's strategy, as plain Java that never sees the Robocode engine.
hadur117.core.melee
Melee (free-for-all) subsystems: opponent tracking, sweep radar, minimum-risk movement, target selection, circular targeting and posture strategy, and each opponent's melee profile block (MMEM-1), driven each tick by MeleeController.
  • Classes in hadur117.core.melee used by hadur117.core
    Class
    Description
    MeleeController
    Runs Hadur's melee subsystems for one tick and returns what the robot should do.
    MeleeProfile
    What Hadur remembers about one opponent from melee battles (MMEM-1): how often its inferred shots hit Hadur, whether those hits were aimed head-on or led, how hard it fires, how often it comes in to ram, and where it usually finishes.
    MeleeProfileFolder
    One round's melee observations of each opponent, waiting to join its MeleeProfile when the round ends (MMEM-1).
    TeamModes.Mode
    A team movement mode.
